They apply to all platforms systematically offering goods or services in India, to advertisers and to sellers, and they are in addition to other laws. A dark pattern is a deceptive design practice that misleads or tricks users into doing something they did not intend, by impairing consumer autonomy or choice, and can amount to a misleading advertisement, an unfair trade practice or a violation of consumer rights. The illustrations in the Annexure are guidance only.

candidate_text: Consumer Protection Act 2019 - Dark patterns Scope: The Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023 were issued by the Central Consumer Protection Authority on 30 November 2023 under section 18 of the Consumer Protection Act 2019.
